title: Together We Are Powerful Impact T-Shirt
description:
Together We Are Powerful Impact T-Shirt

Limited Pre-Sale

Wear the movement. Every shirt helps bring confidence, fun, and fitness to kids and youth with autism and intellectual disabilities across Canada through the MOVE by GoodLife Kids Program. Real impact. Real change. Right now.

Created in collaboration with GoodLife Fitness and GoodLife Kids Foundation, this limited-edition t-shirt supports MOVE by GoodLife Kids, a national program that helps kids and youth with autism and intellectual disabilities access physical activity, fitness, and inclusive spaces across Canada.

This isn’t just merch. It’s a statement of support for inclusive movement and equal access to sport and play.

Pre-Sale Details

  • Pre-sale begins January 19 and ends February 15.

  • This is a limited pre-sale; we will produce only the units sold

  • Once the pre-sale ends, production will begin

  • Production takes approximately 4–5 weeks

  • Shipping follows production and takes an additional 1–2 weeks

  • You’ll receive updates as your order moves through production

This pre-sale model allows us to produce responsibly while maximizing the impact of every shirt sold.

title: The Healthcare Bamboo Zip-Up Hoodie
description:
Back by popular demand.

We originally created this zip-up hoodie to honour frontline healthcare workers, starting with PICU and NICU nurses at the Children’s Hospital, as a way to recognize the care, resilience, and compassion that define their work every day.

Over time, it became something bigger. What started as a small run for healthcare teams quickly turned into one of our most requested pieces, worn by nurses, healthcare professionals, and supporters across Canada and beyond.

So we’re bringing it back, again.

Designed with Purpose

We chose a zip-up hoodie for a reason. For healthcare professionals, practicality matters. A zip-up is easy to layer, easy to remove, and easy to live in during long shifts and early mornings.

Made from an ultra-soft organic cotton and bamboo blend, this hoodie is breathable, comfortable, and built for everyday wear.

What Our Community Has Said

“I wanted something I could wear to work that shows pride in being a nurse and support for local. It feels like standing together without having to say anything.”

“It’s comfortable, well-made, and meaningful. A reminder of the people who show up every day to care for others.”

“This hoodie makes me feel proud of the healthcare community as a whole. It represents compassion, resilience, and support.”

“I bought it to support healthcare workers and Canadian-made at the same time. Knowing it gives back makes it even more special.”

“It’s cozy enough for early shifts and meaningful enough to wear with pride.”

Whether you work in healthcare, love someone who does, or simply want to show your support, this hoodie is a small but meaningful way to say thank you.

title: CAN Giving Toque
description:
The CAN Giving Toque

To meet the needs of Canadian shelters, who are always seeking donations of socks and toques, we created the Giving Garments™ program. This Giving Toque is constructed with 100% high bulk acrylic, and features 2 ply Tomkins 1x1 toque with a folded cuff. In non stitching terms, this translates to an incredibly warm toque that is built strong enough to last you a lifetime. The best part is that when you buy one of our Giving Garments™, we donate a toque to a shelter in need. 

Since starting our Giving Garments™ program, we’ve donated over 8,500 essential items to shelters across Canada. 

Make a difference with your shopping and feel good in this soft and cozy Giving Toque. 

This Giving Toque is a more fitted, standard fit. If you prefer a toque that is not fitted, or tight when wearing, check out our Giving Toques with added length and width here!

title: Giving Socks
description:
If you're like most Canadian's, you rarely go a day without socks. They keep you warm from the cold and feeling cozy when needed. There's quite possibly no better feeling than putting on a pair of soft socks.

Designed with this in mind, these classic and durable athletic socks are made with Rayon from bamboo, making them breathable, terrific at wicking away moisture, and naturally resistant to odor.

But best of all, these socks give back. As part of our Giving Garments™ collection, for every item sold, an item is donated. Socks are frequently in high demand from shelters across the country and you can contribute to alleviating that problem.

Our full length socks should reach roughly mid-shin.
